contributions.detail: Generation-2 county-branded form. Form A holds exactly one inked row, $640.20. The printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS footer cell EXISTS but the filer left it BLANK (anchor ""), verified empty in a 1200 dpi crop, so the cover is the only usable anchor. Cover line 1 reads 0 + 640.2 = 640.2: the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are equal because this is the filer's first (and only) report of the 2024 cycle, so the two scopes coincide; recorded as cumulative. Line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is 0 in all three cells, so line1+line2 happens to equal line 1 here, but line 1 alone is what was scored on per the addendum.
